keySentence: His sisters picked blackberries down the lane.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The sisters walked down the lane. They found blackberries. They picked and ate them. His sisters picked blackberries down the lane.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The three sisters walked further down the lane together. Under a big tree, they found a blackberry bush. The berries looked ripe and delicious in the sunshine. His sisters picked blackberries down the lane happily. They brought a full basket home to share with Mother. Peter only had camomile tea while they enjoyed the sweet berries.
facts.Word cards: blackberries = 블랙베리 🆕 / lane = 오솔길 / down = 따라서 🆕 / pick = 따다 / sisters = 자매들
